For graph analysis on the CPU, the graph-tool Python library is mature network science library implemented in C++ with Python bindings. It runs much faster than NetworkX and iGraph, especially when multithreaded. graph-tool provides graph visualisation via Cairo.
For analysis on the CPU in Python, R, C, or Mathematica, iGraph is a slightly slower alternative to graph-tool. iGraph supports graph visualisation via inbuilt R functions or MatPlotLib.
